facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia's Determination on Localization of Core Banking Systems (BID 19), signed 5 August 2008 and effective 11 August 2008, requires all authorised banking institutions to locate and maintain their core banking systems, where accounting and other banking records are kept, in Namibia.
facts.system: Determination on Localization of Core Banking Systems (BID 19)

facts.fact: The determination, issued by the Bank of Namibia under section 71(3) of the Banking Institutions Act 1998 for the banking institutions it authorises, says that on non-compliance the Bank may pursue any remedial measure under that Act, and it refers to dispensations already granted to individual institutions.

note: Bank of Namibia cloud computing determination (BID-19, 2024) sets a data residency policy duty and prior approval for data movement outside strong-protection jurisdictions, a condition on sending data abroad and not a rule that data must stay; its repeal of BID-19 appears only as a contents heading with no text.
